name: internconnect
description: InternConnect - MERN internship and student community platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.render-build: npm ci --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
